name: google-play
description: Google Play Developer API (Android Publisher) integration with managed OAuth. Manage apps, subscriptions, in-app purchases, and reviews. Use this skill when users want to interact with Google Play Con

en.tagline: Google Play Developer API calls with managed OAuth
en.summary: This skill lets an agent call the Google Play Developer API (Android Publisher) through the maton CLI, or over raw HTTP with a Maton API key. OAuth is managed by Maton, so the user does not handle Google tokens directly. It covers apps, subscriptions, in-app purchases and reviews, and can turn a Google Play read into a scheduled hosted function.
problem: Working with the Google Play Console usually means doing each task by hand, or writing and maintaining your own OAuth flow and API client. Both take time and make it easy to change something by mistake.

With this skill, the agent reads and lists Google Play data through a managed connection. Writes and new connections wait for the user's approval, and the connection can be limited to specific endpoints. A read can also be run on a schedule as a hosted function.
fit: Reading app listings, subscriptions, in-app products or reviews
Checking Google Play data on a schedule, such as a daily read
Making Google Play changes, with the user approving each write
unfit: Calls to other third-party apps, which the skill sends to the api-gateway skill
Endpoints the user has not named and approved, since only the documented endpoints are in scope
steps: Sign in once with `maton login`, which uses a device flow and stores tokens in the operating system's credential store.
After the user approves, create a Google Play connection with `maton connection create google-play` and authorize it in the browser.
Call the API with `maton api '/google-play/androidpublisher/v3/...'`, using read and list calls by default.
If needed, limit what the connection can call by setting an access policy with `maton connection update`.
To automate a read, deploy a hosted function that uses the Maton SDK, after the user approves the handler and the deploy.
Start that function with a trigger, either on a time schedule or on an event from another connected app, since Google Play does not emit events itself.

zh.tagline: 通过托管 OAuth 调用 Google Play 开发者 API
zh.summary: 这个技能让智能体通过 maton CLI 调用 Google Play 开发者 API（Android Publisher），也可以用 Maton API Key 直接发送 HTTP 请求。OAuth 由 Maton 托管，用户不需要自己处理 Google 令牌。它覆盖应用、订阅、应用内商品和评论，还能把一次 Google Play 读取变成按计划运行的托管函数。
problem: 在 Google Play Console 里做事通常要手动操作，或者自己编写和维护 OAuth 流程与 API 客户端。两种方式都耗时，也容易误改内容。
使用这个技能后，智能体通过托管连接读取和列出 Google Play 数据。写操作和新建连接需要用户确认，连接还可以限制为指定的接口。读取操作也可以作为托管函数按计划运行。
fit: 读取应用列表、订阅、应用内商品或评论
按计划检查 Google Play 数据，例如每天读取一次
修改 Google Play 内容，每次写入都需要用户确认
unfit: 调用其他第三方应用，这类任务技能会交给 api-gateway 技能处理
用户未指定或未批准的接口，因为只有文档中列出的接口在范围内
steps: 先运行一次 `maton login` 登录，它使用设备流程，并把令牌存放在操作系统的凭据库中。
用户同意后，运行 `maton connection create google-play` 创建 Google Play 连接，并在浏览器中完成授权。
用 `maton api '/google-play/androidpublisher/v3/...'` 调用接口，默认只做读取和列出操作。
如有需要，用 `maton connection update` 设置访问策略，限制连接可以调用的接口。
要把读取自动化，需在用户确认处理程序和部署后，部署一个使用 Maton SDK 的托管函数。
用触发器启动该函数，可以按时间计划触发，也可以由其他已连接应用的事件触发，因为 Google Play 本身不会发出事件。
